suites.note: Dead-signal defect repaired in batch 13 by implementing the two producers the registry already declared. No dummy producers were added and no contract test was weakened.

Both historical failures encoded obsolete PRE-HARDENING assumptions, not production defects. (1) The manual fixture asserted Grid0821 while production INGOLSTADT_MANUAL_COOKED_TOWNS is exactly (Grid0828,); the fixture was updated to Grid0828. (2) The auto fixture asserted that a dummy xodr_sha256 was accepted via a path heuristic, while production binds the PINNED auto_map_of_record sha256 and explicitly forbids path heuristics; the test now asserts BOTH directions, dummy sha rejected and real pinned sha accepted. Production behaviour was not changed and identity enforcement is strictly stronger than before.
